lines.say: Why do your muscles shake on the last rep?
It's not your muscle breaking. It's your brain.
Your muscle is wired in groups, called motor units.
When you're fresh, small units do the work, smooth and steady.
As they tire, your brain calls in bigger ones.
Big units pull in bigger, rougher bursts.
And the tired ones start firing unevenly.
So the force wobbles. That wobble is the shake.
It just means your nervous system is working hard. Shaking with pain? Stop the set.
Next time: why do you get a pump?
